message_count.description: Approximate count of messages in the thread (stops at 50).

member_count.description: Approximate count of members in the thread (stops at 50).

total_message_sent.description: Total number of messages ever sent in the thread.

applied_tags.description: Array of tag snowflake IDs applied to a forum thread.

member.description: The current user's thread member object, if joined.

ThreadResponse.description: Represents a thread channel within a Discord guild, including metadata and member information.

primary_color.description: Primary color value for the role as an integer.

secondary_color.description: Secondary color value for the role as an integer.

tertiary_color.description: Tertiary color value for the role as an integer.

GuildRoleColorsResponse.description: Represents the color scheme configuration for a guild role.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets

X-RateLimit-Reset-After.description: The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets

X-RateLimit-Bucket.description: The bucket that the request belongs to
